TARGET.DESCRIPTION:
W_USER_D dimension table contains information about users who created or modified records in the source system, from which the rows have been extracted. It has the contact and location information about the users. Since such a user can be potentially an Employee as well as Contractor, qualifying flags are also present in this table for informational purposes.
The grain of this table is at a single 'User' level. This table is designed to be a slowly/moderately changing dimension that supports Type-2 changes out of the box.

For the incremental-load session, this lookup SQL will have an override joining with the staging area table on the Type2 Dimension's natural key column as well as the DATASOURCE_NUM_ID. TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION_DESCRIPTION: IIF(UPDATE_FLAG = 'S', IIF(EXT_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT = DEFAULT_EFF_FROM_DATE, IIF(OD_CURR_EFF_FROM_DT < SCD_VAR, IIF(SCD_VAR < EXT_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT,'S','U'),'U'),'U'), UPDATE_FLAG)

IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'I' OR UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'B' , IIF(EXT_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT = DEFAULT_EFF_FROM_DATE, TO_DATE('01-JAN-1899','DD-MON-YYYY'),EXT_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT),
IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'S', IIF(ISNULL(INP_CHANGED_ON_DT_VAR),SESSSTARTTIME,INP_CHANGED_ON_DT_VAR),
IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'U' OR UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'D', INP_OLD_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT,
NULL)))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'I' OR UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'S', HI_DATE_VAR,
IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'B', IIF(EXT_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT = DEFAULT_EFF_TO_DATE, IIF(ISNULL(INP_DELETED_ON_DT),SESSSTARTTIME,INP_DELETED_ON_DT), EXT_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT),
IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR= 'U' OR UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'D', IIF(INP_OLD_EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT < HI_DATE_VAR,HI_DATE_VAR, INP_OLD_EFFECTIVE_TO_DT),

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'I' OR UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'B' OR UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'S', SESSSTARTTIME, IIF(UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'U' OR UPDATE_FLAG_VAR = 'D', INP_OLD_W_INSERT_DT,NULL))
